sources.name: Court Pace Index database (courtspeed.com)
sources.detail: Court Pace Index readings 2012-2026 for the Grand Slams, Masters 1000s and ATP Finals, compiled from ATP / Tennis TV broadcast data. Centre-court readings; no altitude adjustment.

sources.name: Tennis Abstract ATP Surface Speed Ratings
sources.detail: Published ATP Surface Speed ratings and ace rates as reported by Tennis Abstract. The figures are reproduced as published, not recomputed by this project.

sources.name: Computed history - ATP match archives
sources.detail: Historical seasons use the Jeff Sackmann ATP archive (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0); the current season prefers the TennisMyLife ATP Match Database. Historical events are calculated leave-one-tournament-out, with qualified server and returner rates shrunk toward surface-wide rates using a 150-service-point prior before the neutral clay 1/3, hard/grass 2/3 blend. Pooled returners use the tour-wide prior. Match-level actual/expected ratios are equally weighted, floored at 0.5 expected aces and season-normalised. Live ratings use the same odds equation with a separately documented season-wide baseline. TML data terms restrict free use to non-commercial purposes; written permission is required for commercial exploitation or redistribution.
